title: KITE: Decoupling Kinematics and Interaction for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.22113v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generalizing manipulation policies across robot embodiments remains difficult because standard policies tie the interactions needed for a task to the actions of a particular robot. We study zero-shot cross-embodiment manipulation, where a policy trained on source embodiments must be deployed on a structurally different target embodiment without additional task demonstrations. We introduce Kinematic Interaction Transfer across Embodiments (KITE), which decouples manipulation into embodiment-agnostic interaction prediction and embodiment-specific kinematic decoding, connected through a learned representation of interaction intent based on contact patterns. An interaction policy is trained to predict the intent using demonstration data only collected on a source robot, and shared across morphologically different target robots. A kinematic decoder realizes these intents by learning from synthetic data generated from each embodiment

translated_title: KITE：解耦运动学与交互以实现零样本跨具身操作
translated_abstract: 跨机器人本体的操作策略泛化仍然困难，因为标准策略将完成任务所需的交互绑定到了特定机器人的动作上。我们研究零样本跨具身操作问题，即在源本体上训练的策略必须被部署到结构不同的目标本体上，且无需额外的任务演示。我们提出了跨本体运动学交互迁移方法KITE，它将操作解耦为与本体无关的交互预测和特定本体的运动学解码，并通过基于接触模式学习得到的交互意图表示将两者连接起来。交互策略仅使用在源机器人上收集的演示数据进行训练以预测交互意图，并在形态不同的目标机器人之间共享；运动学解码器则通过从每个本体生成的合成数据中学习来实现这些交互意图。
tldr: KITE通过将操作解耦为与本体无关的交互预测和特定本体的运动学解码，并利用基于接触模式的交互意图表示连接两者，实现了无需额外任务演示的零样本跨具身操作策略迁移。
en_tdlr: KITE enables zero-shot cross-embodiment manipulation by decoupling it into embodiment-agnostic interaction prediction and embodiment-specific kinematic decoding, connected through a learned contact-based interaction intent representation.
